title: Eye-catching assets for your *game*
sub: At Brothers Interactive, we specialize in creating high-quality 3D game art, for the eye-catching assets for your game. Our talented team of artists is comfortable with various quality of game art, ensuring it aligns perfectly with your project requirements.

services.title: 3D Character Design
services.text: Realistic and stylized characters taken from concept or reference to game-ready. High-poly sculpt, clean retopology, UVs, bakes and final textures, matched to your art direction and performance budget.
points: Outfit variants, skins and customisation sets

services.title: Hair & Grooming
services.text: Hair cards and groom variations for realistic characters, with LOD-friendly card layouts and clean alpha and flow maps.

services.title: 3D Props & Weapons
services.text: Organic hero props, weapons and set dressing that hold up in close-up and stay lean in engine. Built modular where it helps your level team.

services.title: Optimisation & Engine Integration
services.text: LOD chains, collision, material setup and import into Unreal Engine or Unity, so assets arrive working rather than as loose files.
points: Unreal and Unity import and validation

services.title: Texturing & Material Creation
services.text: PBR texturing, hand-painted stylisation and material authoring. We match your existing library so new assets sit seamlessly next to in-house work.

services.title: Skinning & Rigging
services.text: Reliable skin weights and production rigs tested against your animation set, delivered ready for Unreal or Unity.

why.title: Experienced Team
why.text: Years of production on shipped indie and AAA titles.

why.title: Optimized for Performance
why.text: Assets built to budget, with LODs and clean UVs.

why.title: Customized Solutions
why.text: We adapt to your pipeline, style guide and tools.
